proposed_from.topic: Characterize the adaptive minimax number N*(n,K,d,tau,s) of size-at-most-s stochastic hard interventions needed to recover the oriented union of true edges across K DAG components with union indegree at most d and mixture-ancestor cyclic complexity at most tau. A query returns the complete barred-copy d-separation relation in the I-mixture DAG, with the observational oracle free and I-mixture faithfulness as the population bridge. Derive an explicit universal-factor frontier over every feasible s, legal full-oracle transcript lower pairs, and exact formulas for directed-tree mixtures and the cycle-free-ancestor class. Upper bounds must exploit emergent-path parent blocking, not merely replay CADIM or an unevaluated decision-tree recursion. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: For Delta=V, the complete CI oracle reduces to surviving descendant sets of targeted roots; 15,600 exhaustive three-node and 76,800 randomized four-node CI checks found no discrepancy. Degree-preserving parent-swap adversaries support feasibility thresholds s=d for cycle-free ancestors and s=min(d+1,n-1) once cyclic complexity one is allowed. Exact supported slices are N*=3 for three-node two-tree mixtures at s>=2, N*=n for cycle-free indegree-one mixtures at s=1, and N*=n at the dense endpoint; twelve positive-rational fixtures passed 6,272 exact probability CI checks. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove matching all-parameter adaptive count bounds by making enough blocker requirements coexist on a legal baseline transcript, or show how adaptation exploits their incompatibility, and complete the arbitrary-tree/cycle-free formulas. EARLY KILL TEST: Independently exhaust the four-node K=2,d<=2,tau<=1,Delta=V full barred-copy oracle, starting with the d=2 parent-swap pair, over every size-two target and conditioning set; any distinguishing answer or failure of simultaneous faithful rational realization stops or pivots the run. seed_details.anchor_locations_read: Introduction, Theorems 1--4 and their appendix proofs, Algorithm 1, and Conclusion.
seed_details.question: Determine an explicit universal-factor formula for the adaptive minimax number of size-capped interventions required for exact oriented-union recovery.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Not a do-calculus restatement: the focal object is a minimax structure-recovery count with an iff feasibility boundary and legal adaptive transcript converses.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the paper's one-pair \(\Delta\)-through-path blocker by a simultaneous legal-transcript packing of parent-blocker requirements, and charge an adaptive policy against that packing.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for mixture-DAG intervention counts, bounded-size lower bounds, blocker covers, and 2025--2026 citing work found no theorem closing this target--method pair.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Varıcı et al. because CADIM already performs \(O(n^2)\) interventions.
seed_details.rebuttal: CADIM supplies only an upper count and the paper's Conclusion explicitly leaves constrained-size count lower bounds open; neither its local necessity witness nor a single-DAG separating system is a legal adaptive full-oracle transcript lower bound.

seed_details.anchor_locations_read: Introduction, Theorem 2 and its unique-path proof, Theorem 3 and its layerwise parent-blocking proof, and Conclusion.
seed_details.question: Derive exact adaptive counts for directed-tree mixtures and for mixtures with cycle-free componentwise ancestor relation at every feasible size cap.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Not a routine tree extension: exact total counts require a new global potential because the union need not be a tree.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace a local \(K+1\)-node path blocker and the per-head topological scan by a global potential that amortizes one blocked unique path across all still-legal union alternatives.
seed_details.destination_search: The closest tree paper studies one known undirected tree and one hidden root; no exact total-count result for unions of directed-tree components was found.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from the tree intervention-size theorem by applying its local test to every ordered pair.
seed_details.rebuttal: That repetition gives only a quadratic upper bound and no exact minimax count; the mixture union is generally not a tree and its oracle aggregates \(K\) descendant systems.

seed_details.anchor_locations_read: Introduction, Lemma 1, Theorems 1--2 and their proofs, Appendix D.1, and Conclusion.
seed_details.question: Give necessary and sufficient graphical conditions for two \(K\)-DAG mixtures to have identical complete size-\(s\) barred-copy separation oracles, with a canonical partially oriented union representative.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Uses the structure-identification motif rather than a local do-calculus argument; the deliverable is a global equivalence class and canonical union representative.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace local pairwise separability by a simultaneous equality criterion for every barred-copy separation statement through the latent selector.
seed_details.destination_search: Hauser--Bühlmann and Yang--Katcoff--Uhler characterize single-DAG interventional equivalence, while the mixture papers stop at observational representations or local edge tests.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate by applying ordinary interventional Markov equivalence to the augmented mixture DAG.
seed_details.rebuttal: The augmented object has linked barred copies, a latent selector, an unknown component partition, and a union target; ordinary skeleton and v-structure criteria neither encode the barred-set oracle nor determine invariant union arrows.

seed_details.anchor_locations_read: Introduction, Theorems 1--5, covered-edge induction, graph-separator search proof, and Conclusion.
seed_details.question: Characterize a verification number for a fixed mixture union by hitting minimal true-edge-versus-emergent alternatives.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Not a relabelled covered-edge number: the primitive alternatives are emergent-nonedge mixture models with unknown union skeletons.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace covered-edge reversals inside a known MEC by full-oracle-equivalent mixture alternatives whose parent blockers may conflict across components.
seed_details.destination_search: No mixture verification benchmark was found; the closest result assumes a known observational essential graph and a single DAG.
seed_details.red_team: A direct relabelling of the covered-edge verification number.
seed_details.rebuttal: Mixture verification must distinguish true edges from emergent nonedges without a known skeleton, so its minimal alternatives are not covered reversals and need not form the covered-edge forest.
seed_details.disposition: not selected because it is better developed after the minimax frontier

seed_details.anchor_locations_read: Introduction, Theorems 1--3, balanced-partition proof, path adversary, and Conclusion.
seed_details.question: Characterize the \(r\)-round size-capped intervention hierarchy for mixture-union recovery.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Not the cluster-default fully adaptive problem: the additional object is the round-constrained recovery frontier.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace chain-component balanced partitioning by a partition of the version space of legal mixture unions under emergent-path blockers.
seed_details.destination_search: The single-DAG paper leaves even its exact \(r\)-round benchmark open and no I-mixture analogue was found.
seed_details.red_team: The single-DAG \(r n^{1/r}\) argument transfers verbatim.
seed_details.rebuttal: Its proof hides a root in one remaining chordal component, whereas mixture answers can remove several nonlocal alternatives and the union skeleton is not observationally known.
seed_details.disposition: not selected because it introduces an additional round parameter before the fully adaptive benchmark is known

seed_details.anchor_locations_read: Introduction, complete-skeleton separating-system theorem, adaptive adversary proof, randomized lower bound, and Conclusion.
seed_details.question: Determine whether bounded-complexity mixtures admit an exponential gap between optimal adaptive and nonadaptive blocker designs.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The gap must hold on a parameterized family, not a single hand-tuned mixture witness.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace distinct column labels for endpoint separation by labels that encode co-targeting of a source with every surviving last-parent blocker.
seed_details.destination_search: Single-DAG trees exhibit a linear-versus-logarithmic gap, but no mixture result under cyclic-complexity and union-indegree caps was found.
seed_details.red_team: Inherited immediately from the one-tree lower and upper bounds.
seed_details.rebuttal: A mixture of directed trees need not have a tree union, and a query reveals the union of several descendant systems, so both the nonadaptive lower code and adaptive centroid progress require new arguments.
seed_details.disposition: not selected because the direction depends on the unresolved full-adaptivity frontier

seed_details.anchor_locations_read: Introduction, generalized cost objective, Theorems 4--5, verification construction, and Conclusion.
seed_details.question: Optimize a mixture blocker policy under heterogeneous node costs and a per-query cardinality cap, with a certifying lower benchmark.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: A weighted set-cover formulation alone is insufficient; an optimality certificate against legal transcript alternatives is required.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the covered-edge forest vertex cover by a weighted hitting problem over mixture parent-blocker certificates.
seed_details.destination_search: Cost-optimal designs exist for single-DAG skeletons, but no cost certificate for I-mixture union recovery was found.
seed_details.rebuttal: The nontrivial question is to prove that the hit alternatives coexist on a legal full-oracle transcript and that the adaptive design is certified against that same benchmark, not merely to solve a supplied set cover.
seed_details.disposition: not selected because it is a downstream objective change

seed_details.anchor_locations_read: Introduction, finite-sample experiments, Theorems 3--4, and Conclusion.
seed_details.question: Convert a separating intervention policy into a fixed-confidence sequential recovery rule whose sample complexity is instance-adaptive to mixture-oracle margins.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: M8 is only the finite-sample rung; the underlying object remains exact structural recovery.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace exact conditional-independence answers by anytime-valid tests indexed by the adaptively selected conditioning triples.
seed_details.destination_search: Adaptive finite-sample single-DAG allocation results do not address latent mixture selectors or emergent-path CI margins.
seed_details.red_team: Standard confidence sequences can be wrapped around CADIM.
seed_details.rebuttal: Faithfulness supplies no quantitative margin, and adaptive reuse of samples across exponentially many conditioning statements makes both stopping validity and optimal allocation new; the required margin model is outside the present oracle kernel.
seed_details.disposition: not selected because it requires an additional separation-margin model

seed_details.question: Characterize the count reduction when a subset of mechanism-varying nodes or component ancestral relations is known before experimentation.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The side information must yield an iff count frontier, not a qualitative monotonicity statement.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Restrict the parent-blocker family using the known domain map and derive a necessity witness respecting that information.
seed_details.destination_search: The anchor notes partial domain knowledge as future work but gives no count theorem; multi-context papers assume observed domain labels instead.
seed_details.red_team: Monotonicity under side information makes the result immediate.
seed_details.rebuttal: Monotonicity gives no exact threshold or count; the hard part is an information-respecting legal transcript pair and a matching compressed blocker design.
seed_details.disposition: not selected because it narrows the model before the no-side-information frontier is understood
